cells.behavior: Go net/http handlers and context cancellation; no Python sync/async function split. Task workers are separate from request goroutines.
At-least-once attempts with acknowledgement after terminal persistence; task effects need idempotency. No universal exactly-once side-effect claim.
Cooperative cancellation in goroutine workers; isolated subprocess mode for killable hard limits. Arbitrary goroutines cannot safely be killed.
Resource layer explicitly supplies scope; ORM does not infer actor permission. Admin/API apply scope before counts, pagination and serialization.
Common operations portable; vendor features explicit and checked. Future connector cannot silently reinterpret unsupported model fields or migration operations.
OAuth/OIDC, MFA, object storage and third-party monitoring use public extension contracts; no unselected hosted provider is assumed configured.
AgentFlow alone owns architecture state and review. This is a new product; prior framework code and specification workflows are not inputs.
